description: This file defines the GrainDirectoryOptions class used for configuring grain directory caching strategies and parameters. It contains enums, properties, constants, and deprecated settings related to cache behaviors in Orleans Runtime.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for grain directory caching strategies and cache parameters, including cache size, TTLs, and strategies like LRU, None, and deprecated Adaptive.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryOptions
methods.description: Default constructor, implicitly provided. The class primarily exposes properties for configuration.
